blocks.prompt: 10. Let \(f\) be continuous, and suppose: \(\int_{1}^{3} f(x)\,dx = 8\). If the average value of \(f\) on \([1, 4]\) is three times the average value on \([3, 4]\), find \(\int_{3}^{4} f(x)\,dx\).
blocks.explanation:
Bilkul sawal 9 jaisa: average = integral \(\div\) lambai.
Diya kya hai? \([1, 3]\) par integral 8, aur \([1, 4]\) ka average \([3, 4]\) ke average ka teen guna.
Find kya karna hai? \(\int_3^4 f\).
Plan: ise \(I\) kaho; \(\int_1^4 f = 8 + I\); dono averages likh kar "teen guna" se equation.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int_{1}^{3} f(x)\,dx = 8\); \(f_{\text{av}}[1, 4] = 3\,f_{\text{av}}[3, 4]\).
Maloom karna: \(I = \int_{3}^{4} f(x)\,dx\).
Tareeqa: \(\int_{1}^{4} = \int_{1}^{3} + \int_{3}^{4}\) aur \(f_{\text{av}} = \frac{1}{b-a}\int_a^b f\).

Dono averages
\[f_{\text{av}}[1, 4] = \dfrac{8 + I}{4 - 1} = \dfrac{8 + I}{3}\]
\[f_{\text{av}}[3, 4] = \dfrac{I}{4 - 3} = I\]
Kyun: lambaiyan \(4 - 1 = 3\) aur \(4 - 3 = 1\) hain. Lambai 1 ho to average aur integral barabar hote hain.
Dhyan dein: \([1, 4]\) ki lambai 4 nahin, 3 hai.

"Teen guna" wali shart
\[\dfrac{8 + I}{3} = 3I\]
\[8 + I = 9I \Rightarrow 8I = 8 \Rightarrow I = 1\]
Kyun: dono taraf 3 se multiply kiya, phir \(I\) wali terms ek taraf jama kin.

Tasdeeq
\(\int_1^4 f = 8 + 1 = 9\), average \(= 3\); \([3, 4]\) par average \(= 1\), aur \(3 = 3 \times 1\;\checkmark\).
